---
name: ecollab-ai-evaluation
description: Evaluate E-Collab AI features with task-specific datasets, baselines, safety tests, regression checks, and measurable acceptance thresholds.
---

# AI Evaluation

Define expected behavior before implementation. Build representative happy-path, edge, adversarial, privacy, and failure cases. Compare against a deterministic or simpler baseline where possible.

Track quality metrics appropriate to the task plus latency, cost, refusal/safety behavior, grounding/citation correctness, and cross-user leakage. Run a fixed regression set after prompt, model, retrieval, or data changes. Do not declare an AI feature successful from a handful of examples.
